Even so, I was confident in my foot speed. People around me
would even praise me, saying I'd become an amazing Umamusume once my body got stronger!

That person just now was my beloved 'Big Sister'!
Though she's not actually my real sister...

Of course she wants to run with all her might. Giving it everything she has,
putting all that sparkling talent to the test—without having to hold back a single thing.

I had no track record to prove I could truly be of help to her.
Still... there's no point in lamenting the "material." I just have to think that much harder—

She was a trainer at the development club I used to attend.
She's super smart, great at her job, and incredibly kind!

Never give up, think things through... and keep styling myself with knowledge.
If I do that, even this body of mine will surely shine its brightest!

—I want to adorn myself with an unprecedented brilliance.
In other words, winning at Sprint, Mile, and Medium distances... A "Triple Crown across Three Categories."

You already know this, but I have a frail body.
It's just my constitution. Ever since I was a little girl...

And so, I'm sorry for making you worry!
I'm all right now. —

Triple-category conqueror! This is hardly the time to be saying things like that, huh?
Though of course, I don't intend to give up on it either.

It was a single notebook. Written on the cover in neat, delicate handwriting
were the words 'Fu-chan's Race Research.' The volume number was—

...I was at a loss for words. It was uncertain if she could even debut, and even if she
did, there was no telling if she could endure the grueling toll of racing.

All that speed... such wonderful raw material,
yet I can't make it shine if I just stay 'me.'

It's just like fashion, isn't it? That's why I thought long and hard...
and decided on the coordination that would make my raw material shine the brightest.

At that moment, what came to mind... was the 'Big Sister' North Flight relied on.
Before I knew it, I had reached for my phone—

Unless I can give it my all, I won't even be permitted to put it on.
It's a challenging ensemble. But—

About my body, about conditioning, about racing... That if I can just find the perfect
coordination for myself, I can make any material shine.

Of course, I understand how difficult that is with this body.
Running with Bakushin O-chan made me realize that all the more.

Her running had completely captivated me. However, the trainer best suited
for her... the one who could truly make her shine, surely wasn't me.

That naturally sparked my interest in racing, so I joined a development club.
I was head and shoulders above everyone else at first, you know? But...

Perhaps from the impact of the fall, numerous memos that seemed to have been tucked inside were scattered around.
As I gathered them up... her daily struggles were laid bare before my eyes—

From the way North Flight spoke, it was clear how deeply she looked up to her.
She was someone she could lean on just like a real little sister.

I was trying to find the upper limit of the speed I can output right now, but...
it seems I pushed myself a bit too hard.

Yet having to hold back, telling yourself it'll all come true someday as you run...
It wasn't hard to imagine how agonizing that must be.

...Ah, me?! Yes, I'm perfectly fine.
I just felt a little anemic, is all.

I was trying to be careful, though. It's difficult once you start running.
After all, not giving it your all is completely counterintuitive.

Even so, she keeps her eyes fixed ahead.
Loving who she is, believing in her brilliant potential—

Yes! Big Sister is...
someone very dear to me, who acknowledged my raw material.

I fell in love with her at first sight!
Big Sister taught me so much knowledge...

Even in the midst of stagnation, her handwriting remained mechanically precise. And precisely because of that...
every single word written felt like an echo of her silent scream.

Just like the other girls and Bakushin O-chan,
to be able to pour everything I have into running at full throttle.

—How could I have ever thought North Flight was fine?
She certainly was clever and mentally strong. But before any of that...

North Flight was smiling brightly. I couldn't sense any strain or hesitation from her.
Next time, she would probably gauge her physical condition even more carefully as she runs.

Analyze, execute, fail. Analyze, execute, fail. Analyze, execute, fail—
Her days of confronting her own body with unrelenting thoroughness were recorded there.

Her brilliance was so dazzling I had to squint. With her sharp mind and unwavering core...
she could surely achieve her boundless dreams, even on her own.

But I was lucky. —I met Big Sister!
Her demeanor was so refined, and every word she spoke overflowed with kindness...

—It was several weeks later that I realized my decisive mistake...
when I heard the news that North Flight had collapsed.

—Huh, Trainer...?
Is something the matter?

'I will never give up. As if I'd ever give up.
It's okay, I can do this. I can shine. It's okay, one day for sure—'

I believe that one day, I'll definitely
be able to make the 'me' I was born as shine!

The girls around me kept growing and getting stronger and stronger.
...Yet no matter how much time passed, I was never able to run at full power.
'—I want to run with everything I've got...!!'
